remarks: An absolute Stunning luxury loft style 2 Bedroom 2 Bath condo located in a private building in downtown Stamford! This unit was completely renovated with lavish finishes! It has an open floor plan with living room, dining room and a white transitional kitchen with all new stainless steel appliances in 2023, beautiful quartz counter tops and tiled backsplash. The enormous windows fill the open floor plan with lots of natural light and gorgeous sunsets of Scalzi park and Downtown Stamford. The spacious primary en-suite with a master bath and a very generous walk-in closet. There's a 2nd bedroom with two closets & beautiful window exposures which is adjacent to a 2nd hallway full bath that provides convenience for guests or daily use. There's a huge balcony with access from the living room and both bedrooms facing southwest with the most amazing Sunsets! No worries about getting to the gym, the complex amenities include its own fitness center with sauna. Notable upgrades include, a BRAND NEW high efficiency central Air/Hot air system, a newer hot water heater and a newer washer/dryer. Parking garage with a reserved parking and an additional covered spot. Easy walk to the Stamford train station, Mill River park and access to I-95. Short walk to everything downtown Stamford has to offer!
